tests.name: Effective description
tests.reasoning: The description opens with imperative phrasing ('Use this skill for...'), is organized around trigger symptoms/contexts the user would report (avails not filling, slate instead of ads, timeouts, specific error codes, channel STOPPED, schedule gaps, etc.) rather than implementation mechanics, and explicitly scopes out adjacent skills to avoid false triggers. It is dense but remains a focused paragraph appropriate to the complexity of the domain.
tests.evidence: Use this skill for AWS Elemental MediaTailor SSAI (server-side ad insertion) and Channel Assembly. Use for ad symptoms: avails not filling, slate or source content instead of ads, empty VAST/VMAP, ADS timeouts or errors...

tests.name: Verbosity and conciseness
tests.reasoning: The body is dense with MediaTailor-specific facts (dimension names, metric formulas, default sampling behavior, quotas) and does not explain general concepts like what CloudWatch or HTTP status codes are in general terms. It assumes agent familiarity with AWS CLI and jumps straight into domain-specific procedures.
tests.evidence: LogConfiguration.PercentEnabled: defaults to 0, and anything below 100 samples sessions, so a missing log line is not evidence of health.

tests.name: Detailed reference materials must not be in body
tests.reasoning: The body embeds substantial reference-style content inline rather than purely linking out, including the full three-way fill-rate diagnostic branch logic with metric names and meanings, the full symptom-routing table, and detailed log group/query descriptions. This is 'detailed material inside conditional branches' that could largely live in references/ssai-metric-reference.md or ssai-fill-behavior.md and be loaded conditionally, yet it's reproduced at length in the body (e.g., the entire three-bullet fill-rate diagnostic split, the full Step 0 symptom table with escalation paths, the DATA GAP template, the five observability gates list).
tests.evidence: ADS fill low AND avail fill low -> the ADS is not returning enough ad time. Pursue `AdDecisionServer.Errors`... ADS fill healthy BUT avail fill low AND `SkippedReason.*` non-zero -> ads are returned but not inserted... ADS fill healthy, avail fill low, `SkippedReason.*` near zero -> the break was never personalized...

tests.name: Reference files must be linked
tests.reasoning: Every file in references/ is linked via markdown link syntax in the body: channel-assembly-checklist.md, channel-assembly-procedure.md, lookup-tables.md, playback-errors-and-limits.md, report-outlines.md, ssai-fill-behavior.md, ssai-log-catalog.md, ssai-metric-reference.md all appear as markdown links.

tests.name: Reference links must specify when to load
tests.reasoning: Links consistently specify when to load each file, e.g. tied to specific steps or conditions rather than generic 'see for details' phrasing.
tests.evidence: load the "Observability preconditions" section of [references/ssai-log-catalog.md](references/ssai-log-catalog.md) when you need the exact field, default, cap or documented trap

tests.name: Reference path format
tests.reasoning: All references/ links use relative paths from the skill root with no absolute paths or traversal patterns.

tests.name: Prescription vs description
tests.reasoning: Fragile operations (log precheck gates, CLI commands, pagination warnings) are given exact prescriptive instructions, while investigative reasoning (fill-rate branch diagnosis, symptom routing) explains the WHY behind each branch, giving the agent room to reason through evidence.
tests.evidence: Omit `--max-results` and all pagination flags so the SDK auto-paginates; passing caps causes errors and `--no-paginate` returns only one page.

tests.name: Defaults, not menus
tests.reasoning: Where decisions involve metric formulas (simple vs weighted fill rate) the skill specifies which to report and defers detail to a reference; no case of listing many tools as equal, undifferentiated options.
tests.evidence: compute weighted averages separately and report which you used (the reference file has the formulas)

tests.name: Favor procedures over declarations
tests.reasoning: The skill teaches a generalizable investigative procedure (routing table, diagnostic branches, metric baseline comparisons) applicable to any MediaTailor resource rather than a one-off instance-specific task.
tests.evidence: Discover dimensions live before querying... Bind queries to the dimensions actually returned.

tests.name: Gotchas section
tests.reasoning: The skill has an explicit section functioning as gotchas: the 'Critical constraint: observability is off by default' section documents concrete, non-obvious traps (sampling, log strategy chain, DEBUG cap) that the agent would otherwise miss.
tests.evidence: DEBUG mode is per session, capped at 10 active sessions, and silently dropped over the cap; confirm it with a `SESSION_INITIALIZED` event.

tests.name: Templates and outputs missing
tests.reasoning: The skill produces structured findings reports and explicitly provides templates via references/report-outlines.md, satisfying the need for structured output guidance.
tests.evidence: Use the matching report outline (SSAI or Channel Assembly) in [references/report-outlines.md](references/report-outlines.md) when compiling the report
